name: Hu tieu with pate
summary: Breakfast hủ tiếu comes with a pork-pâté slice of pig-head skin, pork fat, lean pork, and pepper, chewy, crisp at the edge, and a little rich. The dinner bowl of the same noodle is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro.
origin: Ben Tre town. The breakfast slice is the portal’s plate. The dinner bowl is Vietnam Tourism’s plate. They are not the same bowl.
texture: The 9 June 2021 article calls the slice dai giòn and beo béo: chewy, crisp at the edge, and rich. That is that counter’s slice, not the quail-egg bowl.
howToEat: Eat the pâté slice at breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4. Do not fold it into the dinner bowl.

Vietnam Tourism’s dinner bowl is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. The 9 June 2021 article also names wonton, seafood, and pork-and-bone bowls at the same counter. Those are not the pâté bowl.
where: Đường 30 Tháng 4 for the breakfast slice.
seoTitle: Hu tieu with pate in Ben Tre — two plates
seoDescription: Breakfast hủ tiếu comes with a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro.
